as_of_content:
For every [[Bot]] and module in ''Forged to Fight'', there is an unique '''ability''' or '''skill''' set. These Abilities are the backbone of the Bots and Mods in the game. 

For example, when [[Optimus Prime]] (also applies to [[Optimus Prime (MV1)|MV1]]) blocks, he gains an Armor Buff. [[Sharkticon]]s share certain bits of an ability set with certain Bots.

On this Wiki, they will be listed under the '''Other Abilities''' section.
